name: Zulg Bully (CR 1/2)
body:
ZULG BULLY
CR 1/2

This small creature walks with an odd stance—it holds its short legs up and uses its feet like hands. Meanwhile, its much longer, stronger arms extend down from its shoulders to the ground and allow it to walk. The creature is hairless and has a long muzzle. It carries a shortsword and has a number of javelin-like darts on its back.

XP 200
Zulg operative 1
NE Small humanoid (zulg)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+1 size, +3 Dex, +2 armor)
hp 12 (1d8+3+1)
Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft. (climb 30 ft. in trees if using all four limbs)
Melee shortsword +4 (1d4+1 P, 19-20/×2)
Ranged atlatl +4 (1d4+1 P, range incr. 50 ft.; reload as a free action)
Special Attacks sneak attack +1d6

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 17, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 13, Cha 8
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 13
Feats AntagonizeUM, Rapid Reload (atlatl), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +10, Climb +14, Diplomacy +3 (+4 when using Antagonize), Escape Artist +7, Intimidate +3 (+4 when using Antagonize), Perception +5, Stealth +11; Racial Modifiers +2 Acrobatics, +2 Diplomacy when using Antagonize, +2 Intimidate when using Antagonize
Languages Common, Zulg
SQ weapon familiarity
Gear NPC gear (Small leather armor, Small atlatl with 6 darts, Small shortsword, other gear)

ABOUT

Zulgs are belligerent and self-centered. While they prefer to argue and insult, they are not above turning those quarrels into physical fights if they think there is something to be gained from the altercation.

Galactic Legions, Vol. 2: In the Shadow of the Empire. 2026, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author. Bryan Mangum.
